payload.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
payload.body: ## Pull request overview Refactors `process-pads.ts` by extracting pad parsing/geometry helpers (`pad-utils.ts`), SMT pad creation (`process-smd-pad.ts`), and plated/NPTH hole creation (`process-hole-pad.ts`). `process-pads.ts` now acts as a thin orchestration layer that parses pad fields, creates a `pcb_port`, then dispatches to the appropriate creation module. **Changes:** - Extract shared helpers (pad `at`/`type`/`shape`/`size` parsing, rotation/normalization, roundrect radius, coordinate transforms) into `pad-utils.ts`. - Move SMT pad creation (custom primitives + standard circle/oval/rect/roundrect) into `process-smd-pad.ts`. - Move plated-hole and NPTH creation into `process-hole-pad.ts`, and narrow `padType` to `PadPortInfo["padType"]`. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `lib/stages/pcb/CollectFootprintsStage/pad-utils.ts` | New helpers for pad parsing, geometry, rotation, and coordinate transforms. | | `lib/stages/pcb/CollectFootprintsStage/process-smd-pad.ts` | New module for SMT pad creation including custom `gr_poly`/`gr_circle` primitives and standard shapes. | | `lib/stages/pcb/CollectFootprintsStage/process-hole-pad.ts` | New module for plated-hole variants and NPTH circles. | | `lib/stages/pcb/CollectFootprintsStage/process-pads.ts` | Slimmed to orchestration: parses pad fields, creates `pcb_port`, dispatches to SMD/NPTH/plated-hole modules. | --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews.
